theme: South Australian landscapes, towns, and coastal regions —
bluestone cottages, rugged coastlines, windswept beaches,
wildlife such as kangaroos and blue fairy wrens,
cottage gardens, native flowers, olive groves,
sheep paddocks, dusty backroads, outback colours,
quaint main streets, markets, cafes, and winery views,
young adults and teens in colourful spandex cycling through the landscape,
road cyclists climbing hills, pelotons on country roads,
riders resting at a cafe stop, bikes leaning against stone walls,
all evoking a sense of place, sunlight, texture,
and everyday beauty unique to regional South Australia.
styles: Impasto- applied in very thick layers—sometimes straight from the tube—so that the brushstrokes or palette knife marks remain clearly visible
Anthropomorphic — animals depicted as human-like characters wearing clothes, doing everyday human activities
compositions: Framed through a doorway or window
Rule of thirds with strong foreground interest
